requestedChange: 将牧场外圈改为圆形，保留 5×5 占地、原位置和玩法。四根等长隔栏与附属设备绕中心旋转，端头与固定外圈留出间隙。

attempts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: one transparent PNG game facility sprite, circular rotational ranch inside a 5x5-cell reserved footprint.

Input roles:
1. Edit target: the user's approved square ranch. Preserve its central low olive gearbox, yellow cap and red control lever, four chunky grey metal arms with restrained yellow marks, warm repaired wood/steel fence materials, galvanized feed trough, green water trough and small EMPTY wire coop, and overall hand-painted finish.
2. Geometry-only reference: the new circular ranch on a 5x5 grid. Follow its circular footprint, FOUR equal radial arms, clear swept radius, and low heights. Do not render the diagram's grid, text, lines, blank floor or schematic styling.
3. Approved rendering-quality reference: tier-one street thug, contours and painted volume only. Do not draw a person, sheep, character base or checkerboard.
4. Approved older ranch material/subject reference only. Do NOT copy its sheep, ground disc, thick plinth, floor, fixed-to-fence arms, cartoony simplification or compass orientation.
5. Approved scene style reference: v6 reused transit rack. Use clear variable dark outlines, painted planar light/shade, upper-left light, selective repairs and controlled detail; do not draw a rack.

Primary correction: replace the square/diamond outer pen with a ROUND wooden-and-steel fence, forming an ellipse in this orthographic elevated camera. This is a true circle on the ground, NOT a rounded square, not an octagon, not four straight sides. The whole pen is one circular enclosure, divided into exactly FOUR 90-degree sectors by exactly FOUR equal-length metal radial partition arms attached to ONE low rotary hub. Arms form an X on screen along the two ground axes, slopes +0.7071 and -0.7071 as in reference 2. All arms meet at the exact circle centre; opposite arms are collinear.

Mechanical plausibility: outer fence is stationary. Each arm ends a short distance INSIDE the circular fence, with a small ground support wheel under its free outer end. Do not bolt arm ends to stationary fence posts. All four arm-end wheels follow the same circular radius; retain a small continuous clearance from the fence for a full rotation. No fixed internal dividers, no immovable internal objects obstructing the arms. Mount the feed trough, green water trough and empty wire coop as compact low side attachments to moving arms, nearer the hub than the tips; each sits wholly inside the swept circle, never straddles the exterior fence. Keep each attachment visibly supported by its arm. Keep only the three existing functional accessories, not many duplicates. A closed curved access gate lies flush with the near-left arc, integrated in the round perimeter and not projecting into the sweep.

Camera and scale: orthographic dimetric, no vanishing point, verticals vertical. The ground circle projects to an ellipse with vertical diameter approximately 0.7071 of horizontal diameter. A 5x5 SQUARE reservation projects to a 720 x 509 pixel diamond at game scale; the inscribed circle is about 479 x 338 pixels on the ground, as reference 2. Do not enlarge the circle to fill the diamond's horizontal extreme corners. Fence posts about 40-42px tall at that game scale, low hub about44px, person reference about95px. Allow ample transparent margins around the entire sprite; no clipped posts.

Preserve the source's hand-painted old modern-industrial materials and native orientation. Dark warm contours, blocky readable highlights, worn honey-brown boards, dull iron, faded olive gear housing, tiny local blue replacement slats and rope repairs. No shiny 3D/PBR look, no flat icon look, no dense decorative grime.

Output actual RGBA transparency. All exterior and ALL open paddock ground between objects is transparent. No terrain, dirt/grass painted into the four sectors, no circular display base, no ground disc, no floor slab, no large filled ellipse, no baked ground shadow. The circular fence is an actual fence, not a solid ring pedestal. No animals, people, text, arrows, motion marks, labels, grid or watermark. Show the entire completed circular facility as one clean isolated sprite.

编辑图1的牧场棋子，把方形围栏改为圆形围栏。产出一张完整的透明PNG游戏设施图。

参考用途：图1是要修改的原图，保留材质、画风、中央绿色传动箱、黄色盖子、红色操纵杆、四根金属旋转隔栏以及三个附属设备。图2仅是新的几何模板：5×5格范围中的圆形围场，四根等长放射状隔栏，四个扇形分区；不要画模板里的格线、文字或底色。图3只参考轮廓线轻重与手绘明暗，不画人物。图4只参考木材与金属质感，不画羊、地面或底座。图5只参考已确认的手绘场景美术质量，不画货架。

圆形围栏由有弧度的旧木条和金属立柱围成，在等距俯视角度下呈椭圆；不能仍是四条直边，也不要圆角方形。中央一个低矮传动轴，连接恰好四根等长金属隔栏，沿几何模板的两个地面轴形成X形，恰好分成四个90度扇区。圆心、传动轴和四栏交点一致。每根隔栏的末端带小支撑轮，末端与外圈围栏之间有回转间隙，不固定连接外圈立柱。外圈固定，内侧四栏可以整体绕中心转动。

原有金属食槽、绿色水槽、空金属网笼各一个，改为挂装在转动隔栏较靠内的位置，带清楚的小支架，全部位于圆形回转范围内。内部不要另放固定家具挡住转动。近侧围栏保留一道关闭的弧形小门，与圆周齐平。四个扇区留出大面积透明空地。

画风与图1、图5一致：深色且有轻重的轮廓、手绘色块明暗、左上光，暖棕旧木、暗灰金属、褪色橄榄绿，少量蓝色补板和绳结修补。不要照片或光滑3D质感。保持低矮设施比例，不画成巨型建筑。

正交投影，无消失点；地面两轴斜率正负0.7071，竖线竖直。圆形地面轮廓的投影短轴约为长轴0.7071，匹配图2。占地仍为5×5格，但圆圈内接于这块方形区域，不把圆圈横向拉满菱形的两个尖角。画面完整，四周留透明边距。

必须是真实RGBA透明背景：围栏外、四个分区的地面空隙全部透明。只有实体部件和容器内部有颜色。不要地板、泥土、草地、圆形底盘、展示台、独立地面投影、棋盘格、标注或文字。不要人物或动物。

note: No generated bitmap was returned. No runtime asset, registration or gameplay data changed. CLI fallback requires explicit user selection under imagegen skill.
